data.title: Elwood
data.about:
Elwood Estates in Sobha Elwood at Dubailand introduces an exclusive collection of 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas in a nature-centric masterplan. Developed by Sobha Realty, the community blends architectural refinement with serene outdoor spaces, offering residents a calm, private, and immersive lifestyle surrounded by vast greenery and forest-inspired landscapes.

The Elwood Estates project features amenities such as a lap pool, forest trail, fitness area, yoga lawn, and clubhouses. With a design influenced by the world’s grand forests and an environment enhanced by seamless micro-mobility, sustainability features, and well-curated facilities, it presents a sophisticated setting for families seeking long-term value and strong ROI potential.

characteristics_module.title: A Nature-Led Lifestyle at Elwood Estates in Sobha Elwood at Dubailand
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Crafted by the prestigious developer Sobha Realty.
  • Meticulously designed 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas with covered area ranging from 4,957.86 sq. ft. to 7,186.20 sq. ft.
  • Each park at Sobha Elwood boasts a unique identity inspired by the seven largest forests in the world. 
  • Enjoy an exhilarating lap pool and multiple water sports opportunities
  • Unparalleled elegance in one of Dubai's most sought-after locations.
  • Jog along winding trails in lush, green parks surrounded by over 10,000 trees, and enjoy the pure, fresh air that invigorates your senses.

location_tile.title: Nature-Led Urban Connectivity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Elwood Estates is located in Sobha Elwood at Dubailand, offering direct access to the Dubai–Al Ain Road (E66). The Elwood Estates location combines natural surroundings with excellent connectivity, allowing residents to move effortlessly across key destinations while enjoying a peaceful, nature-rich community setting.

  • 5 Minutes – Dubai Rugby Sevens
  • 8 Minutes – Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
  • 30 Minutes – Al Maktoum International Airport
